column2: The $$大邪神$$ that far surpasses the power of countless demons...
the radiant glory of $$メタトロン$$!!
I-It's incredible!! I-I need to write it in my $$日記$$—my $$日記$$!
Impossible!? The real... $$邪神$$ has returned?!
Well, did you see that, $$ユダ$$?! At last, I have freed the soul of that $$大邪神$$...
Ha! You vile heretics who believe in an $$邪神$$!!
In the name of $$大善神サタン$$, I cannot forgive you!
Kill them!! Massacre every last one!!
